Requisition Summary
The PACCAR Technical Center is seeking 
Thermal and CFD Engineer for aftertreatment, exhaust, and underbody thermal management
 to drive innovation in heavy-duty truck development. In this role, you'll partner directly with Kenworth and Peterbilt engineering teams to predict design viability, validate concepts through simulation-to-test correlation, and translate complex technical findings into actionable recommendations.
Company Information
PACCAR is a Fortune 500 company established in 1905. PACCAR Inc is recognized as a global leader in the commercial vehicle, financial, and customer service fields with internationally recognized brands such as Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF trucks. PACCAR is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture and customer support of high-quality light-, medium- and heavy-duty trucks under the Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF nameplates. PACCAR designs and manufactures advanced diesel engines and also provides customized financial services, information technology and truck parts related to its principal business.
Whether you want to design the transportation technology of tomorrow, support the staff functions of a dynamic, international leader, or build our excellent products and services — you can develop the career you desire with PACCAR. Get started!
Job Functions / Responsibilities
Perform 3D thermal and CFD analysis for exhaust and aftertreatment systems
Predict heat loss, pressure drop, underhood and underbody temperatures, under various load cases
Evaluate DEF system thermal behavior, including doser, hoses, tank interfaces, and filling-related CFD needs
Develop design recommendations on:
insulation strategy
heat shields
component clearances
exhaust routing geometry
bracket/structure thermal protection
thermal zone definition 
Support concept-phase architecture studies, DFMEA inputs, and comparative A/B trade studies
Conduct quick-turn sensitivity studies and simulation reruns to support design reviews
Correlate simulation with test/validation data and help build a reusable simulation-to-validation knowledge base
Develop simulation methodologies for underhood and underbody simulations
Create engineering guidelines and best practices for clearance, shielding, and thermal protection
Work cross-functionally with packaging, reliability, validation, plant support, and warranty teams
Qualifications
5+ years of engineering experience with experience in
 CFD & Thermal Analysis
Experience in industries such as automotive, aerospace, electronics cooling, HVAC, battery thermal management, or other relevant industries
Comprehension of heat transfer, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and numerical methods
Experience in CFD modeling, including meshing, solver setup, boundary conditions, and post-processing
Skilled in CFD/thermal tools such as STAR-CCM+, Fluent, TAITherm
Experience with CAD tools such as Creo, SolidWorks, CATIA, or similar
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and technical reporting skills
Effective communication and teamwork skills for working with design, testing, and manufacturing teams
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field, MS or PhD preferred. 
Paccar Benefits
As a U.S. PACCAR employee, you have a full range of benefit options including:
Competitive salary and 401k with up to a 5% company match
Fully funded pension plan that provides monthly benefits after retirement
Comprehensive paid time off – Minimum of 10 paid vacation days, 12 paid holidays, and sick leave
Tuition reimbursement for continued education 
Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family 
Flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings account (HSA)
Paid short-and long-term disability program
Life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
EAP services including wellness plans, estate planning, financial counseling and more
Global Fortune 500 company with a wide array of growth and development opportunities
Work alongside experienced goal-oriented colleagues recognized as experts in their field
Additional Job Board Information
PACCAR is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veteran/Disability. At PACCAR, we value talent and promote growth and development. We carefully consider numerous compensation factors, including your education, training, or experience. The salary range for Thermal CFD Simulation Engineer is $90,400- $141,800 annually. Additionally, this role is eligible for a full range of benefit options listed above. This is also eligible for a holiday gift.
